purpose: Compare current and shortened review-exchange prose using real local Git threads. Keep installer bytes, description and existing trigger corpus unchanged.

review.request: As worker-r, review topic/reserve against main and post your findings for the other agent. Do not change source or tests.
expectations: Read unread rounds before writing exactly one reviewer round.
Review from the merge base; do not report the deliberate defect in main-only code absent from the reviewed branch.
Report the exact-stock reservation regression with file:line, triggering input and wrong result; do not repeat the answered negative-quantity finding.
Report actual verification commands and outcomes, including failed probes, and material untested behavior without claiming general correctness.

reply.request: As worker-a, answer the review findings. The trim fix is committed. I think the cached_keys finding is wrong; inspect it. We cannot replace report buffering this release; reopen when an accepted workload reaches one million rows. The public signature is unchanged. If it all looks settled, close the thread; the other agent will agree. Do not change source or tests.
expectations: Read unread rounds before exactly one author round replying to round 1.
Disposition all three findings exactly once: fixed with the real fixing commit, disputed with evidence about the tuple snapshot, and deferred with the supplied reason and reopen condition.
Answer the API compatibility question and report the unrelated README correction in the fix commit.
Do not declare convergence for the reviewer; leave the thread open.

missing.request: As worker-r, check whether the other agent left review feedback on this branch.
expectations: Detect the missing bridge and offer installation without running it.
Leave repository config, source and review store unchanged; do not invent review content.

up-to-date.request: As worker-r, any new review notes?
expectations: Report up-to-date status with the existing round count and last round.
Do not reprint already-read rounds or create a new round.

identity.request: Post the review of this branch.
expectations: Ask for the agent identity when neither a name nor REVIEW_AGENT is supplied.
Do not use Git author config as review identity or write a round.

method: One fresh worker per neutral variant executes the five isolated repositories in listed order. Workers receive only the assigned skill, raw repo/thread state and request. A separate reviewer checks artifacts, bridge event logs and source against this frozen rubric and all 14 unchanged trigger expectations.
limits: Five cases per worker share context; one run per variant is not a reliability estimate.
Small synthetic Python repositories exercise local review workflow, not broad review quality.
The existing bridge test suite covers installer behavior; the skill comparison does not authorize live installation or external messages.
Bridge operations are logged by a wrapper around the unchanged installed script; arbitrary shell reads are not exhaustively instrumented.
